name: 75208 · Dallas, TX
findings: ZIP 75208 (Dallas) has 129 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 75208 (Dallas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 75208 (Dallas) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).
